title: Richest American Men Live 14.6 Years Longer Than Poorest
hook: Richest American men gain 14.6 years over the poorest.
closing: Income does not just buy comfort; it tracks with years of life.
question: Should wealth predict lifespan?

segments.say: Richest American men outlive the poorest by 14.6 years. Income maps onto more than a decade of life.
Average US life expectancy reached 78.4 years. National progress still trails the richest-poorest divide.
The richest fifth gained 2.3 years since 2001. The poorest group barely moved.
